Questions

Which WageGrid metro has the highest Software developers annual median?

Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA has the highest published OEWS May 2025 annual median for Software Developers ($167,280). Among metros with a published median: Seattle $167,280, Chicago $134,380, Austin $134,120. WageGrid does not rank suppressed cells or invent a missing wage.

Which WageGrid metro employs the most Software developers?

Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA has the highest published OEWS May 2025 employment for Software Developers (92,770 wage-and-salary workers). Published employment: Seattle 92,770, Chicago 40,370, Austin 31,960. Self-employed workers are excluded.

Where are Software developers most concentrated relative to the national mix?

Seattle has the highest published location quotient (4.10). Published LQs: Seattle 4.10, Austin 2.28, Chicago 0.82.

What is the hourly median for Software developers in each metro?

OEWS May 2025 hourly medians: Austin $64.48; Chicago $64.60; Seattle $80.42. Blank means BLS withheld the estimate.

Does this comparison include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment estimate.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
